Let’s start by checking your phone’s status bar for important indicators (like signal strength, airplane mode, and data status). Please check your status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- No signal or low signal bars

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. After you do this, wait a moment for your phone to reconnect to the network, then try sending an MMS message again.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if the MMSC (Multimedia Messaging Service Center) URL is set. If you’re unsure how to check this, let me know your device type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the process.
